name: What permits are needed for cabinet installation in Berkeley or Oakland?

mainEntity.name: What permits are needed for cabinet installation in Berkeley or Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, permits are not required solely for replacing existing cabinets with new ones of the same configuration in areas like Berkeley or Oakland. However, if the cabinet installation involves significant structural changes, altering plumbing or electrical lines, moving walls, or expanding the footprint of the room, then building permits will likely be necessary. Frasheski Construction handles the assessment of permit requirements for your specific project and can manage the application process as part of our full-service approach, ensuring compliance with local regulations for homeowners in the East Bay.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits aren't usually needed for simple cabinet replacement in Berkeley or Oakland. However, if the project involves structural, plumbing, or electrical changes, or expanding the room, permits are likely required. We can assist with permit assessment and application.
